description: Phase 9 first n=5 direct-distribution campaign candidate on ibm_kingston. This refines the cross-backend affine law from 16 to 32 midpoint cells and measures algebraic-integration quantities from the finite probability law.
rationale: gr_affine_n5 passed the Phase 9 backend-aware audit on ibm_kingston.
A Phase 9 layout audit selected transpiler seed 45678 with predicted noisy TVD 0.025125 and maximum quantity-of-interest error 0.005126.
It refines the strongest cross-backend affine result from n=4 to n=5.
The campaign measures only the direct Grover-Rudolph distribution; amplified QAE remains deferred.

selected_cases.label: affine positive law, 32 midpoint cells
selected_cases.purpose: First direct algebraic-integration scaling candidate at n=5.

stopping_rules: Submit only after confirming the dry-run depth and two-qubit count match the Phase 9 audit.
Promote as a Phase 9 direct-distribution scaling result only if TVD stays below 0.05 and max cell deviation stays below 0.02.
Use quantity-specific errors for all integration claims.
Do not attach Grover amplification in this campaign.
